In this channel I and my supportive team did different kinds of Operations, Plastering, Suture Needles making etc. All these operations and techniques we did on fields as well as in Operation theatre.
The purpose of this channel is to educate budding vets and also have conversation with the people who are eager to know about these operations. As i have got great support and response from all over India. I thank u all who have encouraged by their messages and follow up. 
So please Subscribe and Share my channel.
#thevet
